_comment: Provenance for the adVNTR Polymorphic_Call denylist in advntr_config.json. Production code never reads this file; tests/unit/test_advntr_polymorphic_calls.py asserts the two agree. Modelled on vntyper/scripts/calibration.json, which does the same for kestrel_config.json's calibrated constants. Research use only.

polymorphic_calls.source: hassansaei/VNtyper#267 (2026-08-24); the list itself predates it, from ff9bb8e, 06f520f and d565604
polymorphic_calls.advntr_version: older than 2.0.4; the exact revision was not recorded
polymorphic_calls.criterion: A recurrent event observed in positive and/or negative samples, likely originating from motif differences at that locus rather than a true pathogenic event. Such calls are treated as artifacts. Quoted from the owner on #267.
polymorphic_calls.renders_as: positive flagged, via report_config.json's advntr rule block. Still counted as a finding by is_finding -- the flag downgrades a call visibly, it does not withdraw it.
polymorphic_calls.limitation: The key is adVNTR's State string, which records the event shape -- the repeat unit, the first inserted base and the length -- and not the allele. A recurrent benign insertion and a pathogenic duplication of the same shape in the same unit are therefore indistinguishable to this rule by construction, whatever cohort the entry was derived from. #267 suggestion 4 is to key on something richer; that is not decided.
polymorphic_calls.reachability: Flagging runs after the pathogenic-frame filter (advntr_processing_ins / advntr_processing_del), so every entry must satisfy net_indel_delta % 3 == 1 or it can never fire. Seven entries that did not, and one duplicate, were removed in the #267 cleanup with the owner's agreement; removing them changes no Flag value, and test_advntr_polymorphic_calls.py runs the production filter over the list so a future dead entry fails the build.
polymorphic_calls.open: The owner asked on #267 for the pending entries to be re-measured against the re-analysed renome cohort and decided case by case. That is a data edit to this file plus the rule; no code change is needed for it.

statuses.confirmed_artifact: Confirmed by the owner against known samples.
statuses.pending_renome_revalidation: Carried forward from the original list. Awaiting re-measurement against the re-analysed renome cohort; until then it remains flagged exactly as shipped.

entries.note: Confirmed by the owner on #267 (2026-08-24) as an established artifact; keep flagged.
Collides with the simulated delGCCCA class: 2 of the 3 carriers adVNTR detected on the 2.0.19 benchmark were flagged by this entry.

Collides with a pathogenic single-base duplication. On the 400-run simulated benchmark every dupA carrier adVNTR detects is reported in this state. adVNTR records only the first inserted base and the repeat-unit index (advntr/vntr_finder.py: 'If there are run of insertions, the sequence might differ, but we just take the first base'), so a recurrent benign insertion and a pathogenic duplication in the same unit are the same string. The owner's 6G/7G note on #267 is the same ambiguity from the sequence side: the array carries units with both TTGGGGGG and TGGGGGGG, so a G inserted into that run is placeable either way.
Reported by adVNTR as a secondary state on several of the same simulated dupA carriers.

Repeat_Unit_7.rationale: The owner: RU7 'is a well-known artifact - it shows up frequently in negative samples, and occasionally in positive samples alongside the real pathogenic variant.' Keep flagged. Note separately that RU7, the 48 bp unit, does not occur in GRCh38 at all, so on that assembly the rule flags against a unit the reference does not contain.

Low_Coverage.source: shipped with the initial rule set (ff9bb8e)
Low_Coverage.rationale: Fewer than 10 supporting reads. Advisory, and not an artifact claim about the state.
